question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seen to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows from the Statements

**Statements:**

All mobiles are electronic items.

some telephones are electronic items.

**Conclusions:**

I. No mobile is a telephone.

II. Some mobile are telephones.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
neither conclusions I nor II follows.
